component.name: Paleto Modkit
component.summary: Mod GTA V on Linux: archives, mods folder and OIV packages

description.p: Paleto Modkit is a native Linux tool for modding Grand Theft Auto V, both the Legacy and the Enhanced edition. It opens the game's RPF archives, lets you change them and installs mods packaged as OIV files.

ul.li: Browse the game folder and its archives, nested archives included
Add, replace, extract and delete files, or drop them on the window
Edit XML and META files with syntax highlighting
View, export, replace, add and rename textures, importing PNG or DDS
Edit binary metadata (.ymap, .ytyp, .ymt, .pso) as XML and text tables (.gxt2) as text
Preview 3D models; play, export or replace game audio, radio songs included
Check that the game loads the mods folder, and what it read in the last session
Install OIV packages with a preview of what they contain
Never touches the original game files: changes go to the mods folder

description.p: Encryption keys are not included: they are read from your own copy of the game. Loading the mods folder in game needs an ASI loader, installed separately. Paleto Modkit is not affiliated with Rockstar Games or the OpenIV team.

screenshot.caption: Archive browser with a 3D preview of a vehicle
Texture dictionary viewer: export, replace, add and rename textures
Audio container preview: play, export and replace sounds
OpenIV package (.oiv) installer targeting the mods folder
